samples.xml_description:
<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection circuit for the sequence '10011' using a Mealy FSM.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">State 0</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State 1</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State 2</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State 3</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State 4</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State 5</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state">Current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <wire id="next_state">Next state of the FSM.</wire>
        <wire id="match_condition">Intermediate signal for match condition.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge CLK or negedge RST) begin
            if (!RST) begin
                current_state <= S0;
                MATCH <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (current_state)
                    S0: if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = S1;
                        else next_state = S0;
                    S1: if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = S2;
                        else next_state = S0;
                    S2: if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = S3;
                        else next_state = S0;
                    S3: if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = S4;
                        else next_state = S0;
                    S4: if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = S5;
                        else next_state = S0;
                    S5: if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = S0;
                        else next_state = S0;
                    default: next_state = S0;
                endcase
                current_state <= next_state;
                // Match condition logic
                match_condition <= (current_state == S5);
                MATCH <= match_condition;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
